sections.Profile:
"Mr. Evil" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1978. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two sets of three-bank drop targets, two messenger balls, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Myth and Legend, Fictional Character, Original Theme, Vampires, 1970s, Solid State, Horror
